name: tree-sitter-weft
description: Tree-sitter grammar for the Weft programming language

scripts.build: npm run generate && mkdir -p build/cache && XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/build/cache" tree-sitter build --output build/weft.so build/generated
scripts.parse: npm run build && tree-sitter parse --lib-path build/weft.so --lang-name weft
